verdict.rationale: Reducto offers a single Parse endpoint that converts "documents" into structured JSON, and Edit handles both PDF and DOCX. A competitor founder notes that Reducto supports "other input formats" beyond PDF. However, the pack never lists supported input formats, so coverage of the full mix the story names is unevidenced. Missing for 10: a documented supported-format list for Parse, explicit evidence for PPTX, XLSX, HTML, image and email ingestion, and hands-on corroboration that mixed formats need no per-format handling.
